sections.description:
Short title and commencement

LEGAL FRAMEWORK
LEGAL FRAMEWORK
(REMOVAL OF
DIFFICULTY) ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 37 OF 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan; Extraordinary, Part I, 15th November, 2002]
F. No. 2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
15-11-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:-
1. Short title and
commencement.---(1) This Order may be called the Legal Framework (Removal
of Difficulty) Order, 2002.
(2) It shall come into force at
once.

Chief Executive to act as such till Prime Minister takes oath of his office

LEGAL FRAMEWORK
LEGAL FRAMEWORK
(REMOVAL OF
DIFFICULTY) ORDER, 2002
CHIEF EXECUTIVE'S
ORDER 37 OF 2002
[Gazette of
Pakistan; Extraordinary, Part I, 15th November, 2002]
F. No. 2(4)/2002-Pub., dated
15-11-2002.---The following Order promulgated by the Chief Executive is
hereby published for general information:-
2. Chief Executive to act as
such till Prime Minister takes oath of his office. -------Notwithstanding
anything contained in the Constitution or any other law for the time being in
force, the Chief Executive shall continue to act as such and shall perform all
functions, exercise all powers and pass all appropriate orders till the Prime
Minister takes oath of office in accordance with the Constitution.
